name: Iowa Custom Wood Company, LLC
old_description: Very friendly and willing to work with me so my design came out perfect! All I needed was someone to carve a design I had made on a CNC, but Andrew was more than willing to offer some advice to produce a better outcome! I will be going again when I have another design ready!
about:
Iowa Custom Wood Company, LLC operates from Williamsburg, Iowa, where it was founded in 2009 by craftsman Andy (also referred to as Andrew). The shop began with a focus on custom woodworking, building one-off pieces for local clients and gradually expanding its capabilities to include CNC routing and digital design.

The company produces custom cabinetry, furniture, and specialty projects such as live-edge tables, epoxy river tables, kitchen islands, and architectural millwork. Its 48-by-120-inch AVID CNC router, driven by Fusion 360 CAD/CAM, handles panel processing, sign carving, and complex joinery, while a SawStop table saw and traditional hand tools support bench-side assembly. Finishes range from sprayed film coatings to hand-rubbed oils and hard waxes. All lumber is kiln-dried and sourced from select sawmills.

Primary customers are residential homeowners seeking kitchen remodels, built-ins, and heirloom furniture; the shop has also completed a full interior rebuild of a 100-year-old passenger rail car. Daycare operators, gift buyers, and repeat clients round out the base, with projects often starting from a sketch or 3D model developed in collaboration with the client.

The founder emphasizes generational durability through traditional joinery, safe shop practices, and a design-first workflow that lets customers preview projects in 3D before cutting begins. The mission centers on delivering functional quality rather than volume, keeping each piece a one-off collaboration.
